verdicts.reason: A: the body copy is jammed against the left edge and sits on the teal circle, which is split off from the can. Reading order runs backwards (body copy, then headline), the GLACIER wordmark falls below the headline, and the two badges sit in one row with the CTA at equal weight. B: the teal circle is stranded empty on the far left, cut off from its can, which drifts tiny on the right next to the body copy. The CTA and badges are again one undifferentiated row and GLACIER sits under the headline, but no text collides with a shape and the headline-to-CTA order reads better.
